reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Vuetify (https://vuetifyjs.com/).
Technology stack: vue, javascript, typescript, css.
Component specification: 最后开 Buttons。v-btn 预览 Default 到 Plain 都在。

Visual details from source observation: 我们打开 vuetifyjs.com，标题 A complete design system that works，徽章 #1 Vue UI Library，版本 4.2.0。安装页 Get started with Vuetify 4，命令 pnpm create vuetify。Button 页 v-btn 预览 Default 到 Plain。适合要 Material 风格 Vue 组件的人。核心库 MIT 免费；顶栏 One 与商店是订阅和模板，别和这份组件库混成一回事。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).

offers.scope: Core vuetify package is MIT and free; Vuetify One subscription and store templates are paid
